calibration_decision: UNIFORM signal shape across P0, Pattern A, and Pattern B. All three negative patterns use arousal=low on the base signal. Rationale: (1) Pattern B's elevated trigger intensity (intensity=high) is already encoded at the event detection layer — propagating it into signal arousal would double-encode information that belongs to the event spec. (2) Uniform arousal=low preserves identical Phase 23 aftershock gate behavior across all negative paths (gate depends on valence, trust_shift, absorption — not arousal). (3) An existing contract test (test_pattern_b_signal_matches_p0_output_shape in test_p28_t2_t4_pattern_expansion.py) already encodes the uniform-shape invariant, confirming this is the correct calibrated state. The tick_bridge.py Pattern B block comment was updated to document this rationale inline.
notes: 30 new tests added in test_p28_t6_signal_calibration.py covering: (1) Pattern A exact calibrated base signal fields (8 tests), (2) Pattern B exact calibrated base signal fields including arousal=low and cross-check confirming uniform shape with Pattern A (9 tests), (3) Pattern A post-_adjust_t4 hard caps (3 tests), (4) Pattern B post-_adjust_t4 hard caps (4 tests), (5) Pattern A non-activation boundary conditions for mutual and unilateral endorsement (2 tests), (6) Pattern B non-activation boundary conditions for all 4 non-qualifying combinations (4 tests). Section 8 of docs/t4_negative_behavior_contract.md was updated to: replace the 'Identical to Pattern A' shorthand in Section 8.2.2 with an explicit field table, add a P28-T6 calibration rationale preamble with a 3-point justification for the uniform shape decision, and update Section 8.4 to accurately reflect that all patterns share uniform base signal shape. tick_bridge.py Pattern B block comment updated to document the calibration rationale inline.
summary: Calibrated T4 Pattern A and Pattern B signal shapes as uniform (arousal=low for all three negative patterns), documented the rationale in the behavior contract and code, and added 30 new tests confirming exact field values, post-adjustment hard caps, and boundary non-activation conditions.
